purpose: Teach: 理系/支局/新卒/勘弁/不適切/言い分/脱却/未定

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、理系、絶対、人材、絶対、採用しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I want you to prioritize hiring STEM talent. I'm serious about this.
lines.style: Clipped, commanding opening. Sharp attack on the first word. Each instruction lands with weight. Pauses between clauses like checkpoints. Steady eye contact. The voice of someone used to being obeyed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海外、本気で、絶対、支局、絶対、立ち上げ、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward on the overseas branch launch with full commitment.
lines.style: Measured, respectful delivery. Slight formality in the register. Even pacing, no rush. Demonstrates he's been listening and taking it seriously. A subordinate confirming orders back.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 今年度、本気で、絶対、新卒、絶対、選考、絶対、強化しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: This fiscal year, I need you to strengthen our new graduate recruitment process.
lines.style: Direct and firm. The 'need' lands with quiet authority. No softening, no please—just a clear mandate. Posture in the voice is upright, expectant of compliance.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様、本気で、絶対、勘弁、絶対、して、絶対、いただきたい件、絶対、ございます、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. There is a customer matter that requires their forbearance, and we're handling it with care.
lines.style: Careful, measured tone. Respectful deference to the gravity of the situation. Slight formality in word choice. Calm, professional—protecting both the organization and the customer. No defensiveness, just clarity.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 社員、本気で、絶対、不適切、絶対、な、絶対、発言、絶対、なきよう、絶対、徹底しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Make sure the staff are crystal clear: no inappropriate comments, no exceptions. This is non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firm, uncompromising. Sharp emphasis on the stakes. Slower pace to underscore the gravity. The voice of someone drawing a hard line. Not angry, but brooks no misunderstanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の、本気で、絶対、言い分、絶対、丁寧に、絶対、伺っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're listening carefully to the customer's perspective and addressing their concerns fully.
lines.style: Composed, professional. Deliberate pacing to show attentiveness and care. The tone suggests this is being handled with respect and thoroughness. A subordinate demonstrating competence and accountability.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、本気で、絶対、古い体制から、絶対、脱却、絶対、しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: We need to break free from our old systems and outdated practices. Make it happen.
lines.style: Resolute and forward-looking. A lift on 'break free'—optimism mixed with command. Steady, emphatic. The voice of someone ready to move the organization forward. Finality in the closing phrase.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。プロジェクトの開始日、本気で、絶対、未定、絶対、です、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. The project start date hasn't been set yet, but we're working on it.
lines.style: Neutral, informative delivery. A small note of constraint in acknowledging the date is still undecided. Professional courtesy—updating without excuse. Even tone, slightly apologetic in implication but not in execution.
